{{nihongo|'''Hayatamawakenomikoto Shrine'''|波夜多麻和気命神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Hayatama Wake no Mikoto Shrine''' (はやたまわけのみことじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} located in Aitama, {{ill|Shimoda, Shizuoka|Q653402|qid=Q653402}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}.<ref name="jinjacho">[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4401098 Hayatama Wake no Mikoto Shrine] - Shizuoka Prefectural Association of Shinto Shrines</ref>

=== Overview ===
It is situated on the southern foothills of the Aitama area, northwest of Shimoda City, west of {{ill|Inazusa Station|Q6013908|qid=Q6013908}}.

The date of foundation is unknown, but it is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} and an ancient shrine recorded in the ''{{ill|Izunokuni Shinkai-chō|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}'' as “Junior Fourth Rank, Upper: Ōoi no Myōjin.”<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/hayatama_title.htm Hayatama Wake no Mikoto Shrine] - Genmatsuko</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140110-01.html Hayatama Wake no Mikoto Shrine] - Research on Engishiki Shrines</ref>

In the 6th year of {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} ({{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}}), it was ranked as a village shrine.<ref name="engi"/>
